mcp.advisories: read on OSV 2026-11-11. fastmcp 2.3.0: 8 advisories fixed in later releases (1 critical: SSRF and path traversal in the OpenAPI provider; high: OAuth proxy and auth integration, MCP <1.23 dependency); mcp 1.12.4: 4 advisories, all in the HTTP and WebSocket transports (DNS rebinding, session principal, session accumulation, Host/Origin). The servers use none of these parts: stdio transport only, no OpenAPI provider, no OAuth, no installer; the deployed app does not import fastmcp. An upgrade is a SOUP change for the owner to decide (SOUP-AI-002, Integration_Plan P-7)
